mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worker_bank_cards (worker_id, card_holder, card_number, bank_name, bank_branch, is_default) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{cardHolder}, #{cardNumber}, #{bankName}, #{bankBranch}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE worker_bank_cards SET card_holder = #{cardHolder}, card_number = #{cardNumber}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_branch = #{bankBranch}, is_default = #{isDefault} WHERE worker_id = #{workerId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, card_holder, card_number, bank_name, bank_branch, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM worker_bank_cards WHERE worker_id = #{workerId}
SELECT id, worker_id, card_holder, card_number, bank_name, bank_branch, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM worker_bank_cards WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC
